def process(roman_cities):
    import pandas as pd
    s = roman_cities['Select Bibliography'].dropna().astype(str)
    # Split on semicolons, strip whitespace, drop trailing periods
    tokens = (
        s.str.split(';')
         .explode()
         .astype(str)
         .str.strip()
         .str.replace(r'\.+$', '', regex=True)
    )
    tokens = tokens[tokens.ne('')]
    return pd.DataFrame({'unique_sources_count':[int(tokens.nunique())]})
